rows.omission: Cumulative counts are an advanced-structure omission hidden by the old choose-one project. Correct prefix sums do not establish correct inverse selection. Zero counts and rank exactly on a partial sum distinguish strict from non-strict comparisons. Rounding aggregate nodes can disagree with rounding individual frequencies; the inspected original also has a published correction.
rows.rationale: The existing selected advanced structure and verification/specialized algorithm objectives admit this mechanism. T14.14.a specifically names B-trees/skip lists/probabilistic filters and T14.14.c concerns persistence/probability; neither is credited by these exact indexes. Headings and choose-one work were insufficient evidence; explicit facets are added without replacing other mechanisms.
